$comment: The splash: what the page covers and the ordered list of sections with one-line descriptions. Prose only; the figures it mentions are cited where they appear in the sections.

intro.lede: Flock Safety reports more than 120,000 license plate reader cameras in 49 states. This page documents one Falcon unit at scale: the pole and mount, each internal component, the power and network connections, the data path from capture to deletion, common claims against the public record, and pricing and contract terms.
intro.sources: Sources are Flock Safety's specification sheets, price lists and data-architecture document, three independent teardowns, audit logs released under public records requests, and court and congressional records. Each figure carries a citation. Statements from Flock and from independent sources are labelled separately; where they differ, both are cited.

sections.label: Deployments
sections.title: Deployments and contracts
sections.blurb: Where the contracts are public, the largest documented contracts by agency, the public funding behind them, and documented camera counts by city.

sections.label: Inside
sections.title: Inside the enclosure
sections.blurb: Fourteen components from the bezel to the clamps, each with its function, specifications, part number and sources; then the pole and mount configurations and the power and cable options.

sections.label: Data
sections.title: Data path
sections.blurb: Twelve stages from capture to deletion with the processing location and payload at each, retention presets, and a documented network search.

sections.label: Journey
sections.title: Where the picture goes
sections.blurb: One photograph followed like a parcel: seven stops from the pole to deletion, what is in the package at each, who can open it, and how long it takes.

sections.label: Outcomes
sections.title: What the reads produce
sections.blurb: Every public record that ties a camera to a result: reads, alerts, wrong alerts, stops, recoveries and arrests, per camera site where an agency published it, joined to the mapped cameras.

sections.label: Claims
sections.title: Common claims
sections.blurb: The product line, then twenty-one common claims checked against the public record, each with sources.

sections.label: Economics
sections.title: Economics
sections.blurb: List prices, what the annual fee includes and excludes, fee schedules, price history, installation workflow, permitting, contract terms and scale.

sections.label: Sources
sections.title: Sources
sections.blurb: Every source grouped by origin, with the date each was last checked.
